questionEn: Which statement about “alcohol is poured into a lamp” is correct?
questionUz: “Spirtli ichimliklar chiroqqa quyiladi” haqidagi qaysi gap to‘g‘ri?
choicesEn: Up to ½ part of the vessel
All the way to the top
Together with water to full volume
explanationEn: Pour alcohol to half the vessel.
